svg.aria-label: Student Management: A legacy Swing + Oracle desktop app rebuilt as a cloud REST service with analytics and CSV export. Pipeline: BUILD, HARDEN, DEPLOY, LIVE complete. Hardened with no secrets in source, needless PII removed, CI on every push. Stack: Spring Boot · Neon · Actions.
